project.name: ETCSL on Oracc
project.blurb:
The project etcslatf contains a hybrid version of the ETCSL data. The transliterations are the versions adapted for use with ePSD2; the translations were retrieved from https://ota.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/repository/xmlui/handle/20.500.12024/2518 on 2026-04-20.
The original conversion of the transliterations was done by Steve Tinney in 2006; they have been lightly updated over time to keep the lemmatization aligned with the development of ePSD2. The conversion of translations and organization into an Oracc project was done by Steve Tinney in April 2026.
